name: ablation-17-3
note: MOD_PLAN Phase 17 item 17.3. NOTHING HAS BEEN MEASURED with this plan. Written 2026-11-11 on dev/p17/ablate. Every env name and flag below was grepped in src/ include/ serve/ (python3 tools/pancake/ablate_greedy.py THIS_FILE --dry-run prints the check); the preset already has STRATA_VERIFY_DEFER_CPU=1, STRATA_EXPDEC_DOWN=1, STRATA_POOL_FUSE_PHASES=1, --spec 4, --adapt-swaps 32, --adapt-every 1, --lookup-max-t 12, STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=0. Cost: round 1 = (candidates + 1) arms x 3 starts (reps 9, block 3): --group core is 9 candidates = 30 starts, all groups = 19 candidates = 60 starts; each later round is smaller; --only / --exclude trim further. Groups: core = the items named in the Phase 17 task (router-fuse is core but disabled), extra = the other coded-and-untested items with a verified switch, disabled = listed with the reason they cannot be tested on this preset. kv-grow / STRATA_KV_RING_ADAPT (17.4) are not here: the adaptive ring is not in this tree (grep finds no STRATA_KV_RING_ADAPT), and the ring is a long-context item that needs its own 64K / 100K runs.

candidates.name: swaps-auto
candidates.note: MOD_PLAN A8 (Pie): online swap budget; bench/specs/25-a8-confirm.json flags it lossy (cache placement changes the CPU/GPU split under deferral). Source: include/strata/program/swap_budget.hpp, src/program/generate.cpp. Rejected on the async tier in test 02 (-9.6% short), screen n=2 on the blocking tier looked positive.

candidates.name: kmiss-async
candidates.note: MOD_PLAN A5: admit on the k-th miss in W windows; needs the async tier (the blocking tier stalls the GPU about 5.6 ms per swap round, PANCAKE_STATUS). --adapt-async 1 on a HIP build is opt-in and the engine turns STRATA_ADAPT_OVERLAP (in the preset) off when it is given (src/program/generate.cpp near the 'o.adapt_async ? "--adapt-async"' line), so this arm also changes that. bench/specs/15-kmiss.json flags it lossy (rounding-level, different text). Source: include/strata/program/kmiss_tier.hpp.

candidates.name: acceptmoe-depth
candidates.note: MOD_PLAN 23 (AcceptMoE depth-graded verify prior): STRATA_ROUTE_PRIOR_DEPTH only acts together with STRATA_ROUTE_PRIOR > 0 (src/core/verify.cpp: the graded call sits inside 'route_prior > 0'), so the arm sets both, as bench/specs/06-turbo-depth.json does. Source: src/core/verify.cpp, include/strata/kernels/route_prior.hpp.

candidates.name: turbo
candidates.note: The lossy router prior (turbo). Source: src/core/verify.cpp STRATA_ROUTE_PRIOR.

The ledger says --lookup-chain 2 pays only after tail skip. Source: src/core/expert_source.cpp:4927, src/program/generate.cpp.

candidates.name: lookup-chain2
candidates.note: MOD_PLAN 17.4: --lookup-chain 2 (xyzzing rdna3-inference-ledger: paid only after tail skip, +6% at 1K, +20% at 128K on their 7900 XTX). The preset leaves it at the engine default 0; bench/specs/13-lookup.json tests 3. Declared exact (bench/specs/13-lookup.json). Source: src/program/generate.cpp ('--lookup-chain', clamp 0..7). Credit rule: if it is adopted, README section 9 + RESEARCH_AND_FINDINGS section 4 in the same commit.

candidates.name: spec5
candidates.note: MOD_PLAN 17.4: --spec 5 (the preset has 4). Source: src/program/generate.cpp ('--spec').
